items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: That's the only time I ever recorded for Charles Delauney.

ctx.x: Now being fresh from New York, from America, they pick on you. You fresh from New York, they don't care they pick on you right away, Oh, he's just from New York, from America, so we're going to record him. That's the only time I ever recorded for Charles Delauney.
